lastToolError.data: png" or "webp" + background="transparent"; OpenAI also supports openai.background and routes default model to gpt-image-1.5. Use action="list" for providers/models/readiness/auth, "status" for active task.

model.description: Provider/model override, e.g. openai/gpt-image-2; transparent OpenAI: openai/gpt-image-1.5.

filename.description: Output filename hint; basename preserved in managed media dir.

background.description: Background: transparent, opaque, auto. Transparent needs png/webp output.

lastToolError.name: memory_get
lastToolError.description: Safe exact excerpt read from MEMORY.md or memory/*.md. Defaults to a bounded excerpt when lines are omitted, includes truncation/continuation info when more content exists, and `corpus=wiki` reads from registered compiled-wiki supplements.

lastToolError.name: memory_search
lastToolError.description: Mandatory recall step: semantically search MEMORY.md + memory/*.md (and optional session transcripts) before answering questions about prior work, decisions, dates, people, preferences, or todos. Optional `corpus=wiki` or `corpus=all` also searches registered compiled-wiki supplements. `corpus=memory` restricts hits to indexed memory files (excludes session transcript chunks from ranking). `corpus=sessions` restricts hits to indexed session transcripts (same visibility rules as session history tools). If response has disabled=true, memory retrieval is unavailable and should be surfaced to the user.

lastToolError.name: message
lastToolError.description: Send/delete/manage channel messages. Supports actions: send.

target.description: Recipient/channel: E.164 for WhatsApp/Signal, Telegram chat id/@username, Discord/Slack/Mattermost <channelId|user:ID|channel:ID>, or iMessage handle/chat_id

buffer.description: Base64 attachment payload; data URL ok.

forceDocument.description: Send image/GIF/video as document; avoids compression.

lastToolError.name: nodes
lastToolError.description: Discover/control paired nodes: status, describe, pairing, notify, camera/photos/screen/location/notifications/invoke. Use file_fetch for files.

lastToolError.name: pdf
lastToolError.description: Analyze PDFs with model. Anthropic/Google native PDF when supported; else text/image extraction. Use pdf for one, pdfs for max 10; prompt says what to inspect.

lastToolError.name: process
lastToolError.description: Manage running exec sessions for commands already started: list, poll, log, write, send-keys, submit, paste, kill. Use poll/log when you need status, logs, quiet-success confirmation, or completion confirmation when automatic completion wake is unavailable. Use poll/log also for input-wait hints. Use write/send-keys/submit/paste/kill for input or intervention. Do not use process polling to emulate timers or reminders; use cron for scheduled follow-ups.

sessionId.description: Session id for actions other than list

keys.description: Key tokens to send for send-keys

hex.description: Hex bytes to send for send-keys

timeout.description: For poll: wait up to this many milliseconds before returning; max 30000 ms, higher values are clamped to 30000

lastToolError.name: read
lastToolError.description: Read the contents of a file. Supports text files and images (jpg, png, gif, webp). Images are sent as attachments. For text files, output is truncated to 2000 lines or 50KB (whichever is hit first). Use offset/limit for large files. When you need the full file, continue with offset until complete.

path.description: Path to the file to read (relative or absolute)

offset.description: Line number to start reading from (1-indexed)

limit.description: Maximum number of lines to read

lastToolError.name: session_status
lastToolError.description: Show /status-like card for current/visible session: model, usage, time, cost, tasks. Use `sessionKey="current"` for current session; UI labels like `openclaw-tui` are not keys. `model` sets session override; `model=default` resets. Use for active model/session config questions.

lastToolError.name: sessions_history
lastToolError.description: Fetch sanitized history for visible session. Use before replying, debugging, resuming; supports limits/tool messages.

lastToolError.name: sessions_list
lastToolError.description: List visible sessions; filter by kind, label, agentId, search, activity. Use before sessions_history or sessions_send target selection.

lastToolError.name: sessions_send
lastToolError.description: Send message to visible session by sessionKey/label, or configured agent by agentId. Thread-scoped chats rejected; target parent channel session. Creates missing configured-agent main session; waits for reply when available.

lastToolError.name: sessions_spawn
lastToolError.description: Spawn clean child session; default `runtime="subagent"`. `mode="run"` one-shot background work. Subagents inherit parent workspace. Native subagents get task in first visible `[Subagent Task]` message. Native only: `context="fork"` only when child needs current transcript; else omit or `isolated`. Use for fresh child-session work.

taskName.description: Stable alias for later targeting; lowercase letters/digits/underscores, starts letter.

context.description: Native context. Omit/"isolated" for clean child; "fork" only when child needs requester transcript.

lastToolError.name: sessions_yield
lastToolError.description: End current turn. Use after spawning subagents; results arrive as next message.

lastToolError.name: subagents
lastToolError.description: List/kill/steer spawned subagents for requester session. If sessions_yield exists, use it for completion; do not poll wait loops.

lastToolError.name: tts
lastToolError.description: Use only for explicit audio intent (voice/speech/TTS) or active TTS config. Never use for ordinary text replies. Audio auto-delivered from tool result; after success follow reply instructions, no duplicate text/audio.

lastToolError.name: video_generate
lastToolError.description: Create videos. Session chats: background task; do not call video_generate again for same request; wait completion, then send attachments via message tool. "status" checks active task. Duration may round to provider-supported value.

imageRoles.description: `image` + `images` roles by index after de-dupe. Values: first_frame, last_frame, reference_image; empty string leaves unset.

videoRoles.description: `video` + `videos` roles by index after de-dupe. Value: reference_video; empty string leaves unset.

filename.description: Output filename hint; basename preserved in managed media dir.

aspectRatio.description: Aspect ratio: 1:1, 16:9, 9:16, "adaptive", or provider value; unsupported normalized/ignored.

resolution.description: Resolution: 480P, 720P, 768P, 1080P, 4K, or provider value; unsupported normalized/ignored.

durationSeconds.description: Target seconds; may round to nearest supported duration.

providerOptions.description: Provider JSON options, e.g. {"seed":42}. Keys/types must match provider capabilities; mismatch skips candidate. Use action=list for accepted keys.

lastToolError.name: web_fetch
lastToolError.description: Fetch URL and extract readable markdown/text. Lightweight page access; no browser automation.

lastToolError.name: web_search
lastToolError.description: Search web for current info; returns normalized provider results.

lastToolError.name: write
lastToolError.description: Write content to a file. Creates the file if it doesn't exist, overwrites if it does. Automatically creates parent directories.

path.description: Path to the file to write (relative or absolute)

content.description: Content to write to the file
